subject: Post-demo: clarification on decision factors, hosting preference, and procurement contacts
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@healthsync.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + quick confirmations (latency/cost/hosting)

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and can hand this to procurement/legal: 

Call highlights (as we captured):
- Economic buyer: Amit Patel (CTO) — Amit asked for p95 latency targets and cost sensitivity.
- Security/legal: they want SOC 2 evidence, DPA, and confirmation that customer-controlled KMS is supported for keys.
- Procurement: prefers a PO-based purchase; stated typical terms are Net-30 but open to Net-45 for pilot.
- Deployment preference: HealthSync indicated they prefer private deployment (VPC) if PHI is involved, otherwise dedicated reserved capacity is acceptable.

Decision criteria we heard (please confirm):
1) Latency: p95 <= 150ms for 2–4 concurrent user sessions at 4k–8k context.
2) Cost: target < $10 per 1M tokens (total cost-of-inference guidance for eval).
3) SLA: 99.9% uptime for production; pilot ok with 99% if on dedicated capacity.

Next asks / action items:
- Priya / Amit: please confirm the latency p95 target and whether PHI will be in scope for the pilot vs only for production.
- Procurement: please share the procurement contact + preferred contract cadence (PO vs subscription) and any standard SOW templates you use.
- Legal/security: if you can share the primary checklist or the person who will own the SOC2/DPA review, we’ll route the documents.

I’ve attached a simple decision matrix and a short SLO examples doc that maps common Redwood deployment options to latency/cost tradeoffs. Aditya and Neha are cc’d — they can validate the performance numbers and provide a short note on recommended capacity for the pilot.

I’ll follow up with a suggested mutual action plan once we have procurement/legal contacts.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-decision-matrix.xlsx; redwood-slo-examples.pdf
From: Priya Rao <priya@healthsync.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Patel <amit.patel@healthsync.com>, Marcel Gomez <marcel.gomez@healthsync.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick confirmations (latency/cost/hosting)

Thanks Hannah — great demo and clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming economic buyer: Amit is the final sign-off. He’ll want a short technical note on how you achieve p95 and an estimate for the pilot.
- PHI scope: pilot will be non-PHI; production likely PHI. So we need to understand options for private VPC/on-prem for prod.
- Security: legal has asked that we confirm customer-managed KMS and attest that keys never leave the customer boundary. They also requested a short exec summary of your security posture — I attached the requested one.
- Procurement contact: please include procurement@healthsync.com in convo; Marcel (cc) will lead procurement. Our preferred standard is PO + Net-30 for pilots, but I mentioned Net-45 is possible if there’s an enterprise discount/commitment.

Timeline: Procurement review typically 1–2 weeks once they have the pricing deck and SOW. Legal review can run in parallel (2–3 weeks depending on redlines).

I’ll ask Amit to confirm the p95 target in a follow-up note. 

Best,
Priya
Head of Product, HealthSync
Attachment: healthsync-security-exec-summary.pdf
From: Marcel Gomez <marcel.gomez@healthsync.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@healthsync.com>
Cc: legal@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick confirmations (latency/cost/hosting)

Hannah — quick procurement note from my side:

- Please send a pricing deck that shows list vs committed reserved capacity pricing, and an example SOW for a pilot (deliverables, timelines, acceptance criteria).
- Our procurement team will evaluate PO terms; Net-30 is preferred. We do ask for a small discount for >6 month committed capacity (we can discuss tiers).
- Please include any standard security addenda or DPA you use so legal can start reviewing.

I’ll schedule a 30-min intro between procurement/legal and your commercial team once we have those docs.

-Marcel
Marcel Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager, HealthSync
marcel.gomez@healthsync.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcel Gomez <marcel.gomez@healthsync.com>, Priya Rao <priya@healthsync.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick confirmations (latency/cost/hosting)

Thanks Marcel / Priya — Laura here (Customer Success). We’ll get the pricing deck and a sample pilot SOW over by EOD Wednesday. A couple of quick clarifications from our side for the engineering notes: 

- Latency verification: Aditya / Neha, can you confirm whether a 3x A100-equivalent dedicated pool with continuous batching would comfortably meet p95 <= 150ms at 4k context and modest concurrency (2–4 sessions)? If not, specify the recommended capacity for the pilot and the expected per-token cost under that config.
- KMS: security asked for RFP-level language that keys are customer-managed; legal will appreciate a short bullet-list they can use for redlines.

Marcel — if Net-30 is firm on your side, we’ll show list + committed pricing and a suggested discount schedule. We can be flexible on Net-45 for the pilot if there is a path to committed capacity.

I’ll open a shared drive folder for the mutual action plan and post the pricing deck + SOW there (link below). Would you prefer a procurement intro call on Thursday or Friday?

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Related link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/decision-docs-HS-042
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + quick confirmations (latency/cost/hosting)

Quick technical confirmation for the thread: 

- Pilot (non-PHI) on Dedicated pool: a 3x A100-equivalent pool with continuous batching and KV cache for repeated prompts should hit p95 ~ 120–160ms at 4k context for 2–4 concurrent sessions in our benchmarks (depends on prompt shape). For 8k context we recommend bumping to 4x to keep p95 under 150ms.
- Estimated cost: pilot-level reserved capacity (3x) ~ $8–12 per 1M tokens depending on batching and cache hit rates; with conservative assumptions, plan on ~$10 per 1M as a planning number. Committed capacity discounts scale down unit cost.
- Private VPC / production: we support customer-managed KMS and VPC peering; we’ll provide a short attestation and an example DPA clause for legal.

I’ll attach a short performance note and recommended capacity sketches to the shared folder. Happy to jump on a 20-min deep-dive with Amit if helpful.

-Aditya
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-performance-note.pdf
